title: projectOverviewItems
responsibility: Converts tracker items and times into display fields and orders work by live session and due date.

inputs.name: isoTime.value
inputs.description: A validated tracker time string.

inputs.name: isWithin.updatedAt
inputs.description: The tracker timestamp being checked against the time window.

inputs.name: isWithin.windowMs
inputs.description: The length of the look-back window in milliseconds.

inputs.name: isWithin.now
inputs.description: Epoch milliseconds used to compare tracker timestamps.

inputs.name: toOverviewItem.record
inputs.description: The tracker item after sensitivity and state filtering.

inputs.name: toOverviewItem.live
inputs.description: Whether a live run maps to this item.

inputs.name: toOverviewItem.now
inputs.description: Epoch milliseconds used to compare tracker timestamps.

inputs.name: toCallout.record
inputs.description: The tracker item after sensitivity and state filtering.

inputs.name: toCallout.text
inputs.description: The text to inspect before displaying it.

inputs.name: toCallout.live
inputs.description: Whether a live run maps to this item.

inputs.name: toCallout.now
inputs.description: Epoch milliseconds used to compare tracker timestamps.

inputs.name: compareItems.a
inputs.description: The first item or value to compare.

inputs.name: compareItems.b
inputs.description: The second item or value to compare.

inputs.name: compareText.a
inputs.description: The first item or value to compare.

inputs.name: compareText.b
inputs.description: The second item or value to compare.

outputs.name: DAY_MS
outputs.description: The number of milliseconds in a day.

outputs.name: WEEK_MS
outputs.description: The number of milliseconds in seven days.

outputs.name: isoTime
outputs.description: The tracker timestamp formatted in UTC ISO form.

outputs.name: isWithin
outputs.description: Whether the timestamp falls within the specified look-back window.

outputs.name: toOverviewItem
outputs.description: The fields needed to display an included tracker item.

outputs.name: toCallout
outputs.description: The display item and its redacted question or blocked reason.

outputs.name: compareItems
outputs.description: A numeric ordering for display items, with active work first, then due date.

outputs.name: compareText
outputs.description: A numeric lexical ordering of the two input strings.
